name: CarbonPlan Open Climate Risk
description: Building-level wildfire risk.

name: cboettig fire
description: Historical burned-area perimeters and hazard potential.

name: bkr observations
description: Weather station, radiosonde, and aviation observations.

name: giswqs National Wetlands Inventory
description: National Wetlands Inventory.

name: USFS probabilistic wildfire risk burn probability
description: Burn probability and flame-length grids.

name: Wildfire Risk to Communities (summary)
description: Wildfire risk summary.

name: Wildfire Risk to Communities (detail)
description: Wildfire risk publication data.

name: NOAA weather alerts
description: Forecasts and active alerts, including Red Flag Warnings.

name: NOAA HMS fire and smoke product
description: Daily smoke plume and fire detection polygons.

name: NOAA NGFS fire detections
description: Next Generation Fire System GOES-East/West pixel-level active-fire detections, updated every 5 minutes (every minute for mesoscale scans) via an OGC API.

name: NOAA NGFS fire features
description: Fire events grouped from NGFS detections, with fire radiative power, duration, matched NIFC incidents, and NWS fire weather zones.

name: NOAA NGFS fire alerts
description: Current NGFS new-fire alerts with county, state, NWS office, and confidence.

name: NOAA NGFS satellite imagery
description: Terrain-corrected GOES-East/West GeoColor, fire temperature, and infrared imagery tiles via an OGC API and WMS.

name: GOES-R ABI Fire/Hot Spot Characterization
description: GOES-East/West fire detections with fire temperature, area, and radiative power as NetCDF, every 5 minutes for CONUS.

name: GOES-R Geostationary Lightning Mapper
description: Lightning flashes, groups, and events every 20 seconds, useful for lightning-ignition risk.

name: NOAA VIIRS Enterprise Active Fire (EFIRE)
description: 375 m VIIRS I-band active-fire detections from Suomi NPP and NOAA-20/21, per satellite granule.

name: NOAA Regional ABI and VIIRS Emissions (RAVE)
description: Hourly North American wildfire emissions (PM2.5, CO, CO2, and more) and fire radiative power at 3 km and 13 km; the server keeps 6 months.

name: NOAA Global Biomass Burning Emissions (GBBEPx)
description: Daily global 0.1° biomass-burning emissions and fire radiative power from VIIRS; the server keeps 30 days.

name: NOAA Storm Events Database
description: Historical disaster impacts by county.

name: NASA FIRMS KML fire footprints
description: Regional active-fire footprint polygons.

name: WFIGS / National Interagency Fire Center
description: Current and historical fire perimeters from USFS, BLM, NPS, FWS, and BIA data.

name: MODIS NDVI
description: Vegetation-health data useful as a live fuel-condition proxy.

name: OpenStreetMap infrastructure extract
description: Water lines, power lines, hydrants, and roads for response-capacity analysis.

name: USDA LANDFIRE
description: Wildland fire data, including seasonal fuels.

name: Pyregence data repositories
description: Wildfire modeling, fuels, and risk datasets.

name: AlertCalifornia
description: Fire camera imagery and live fire monitoring network.

name: USGS Burn Severity Portal
description: Burned-area boundaries and burn severity, including MTBS and BAER products.

name: CAL FIRE FRAP data
description: California fire history perimeters, fire threat, fuel rank, and forest data.

name: WIFIRE Firemap
description: Wildfire monitoring and fire behavior forecasting maps from UC San Diego.

name: Sentinel-2 NDVI via Copernicus Data Space
description: Live fuel-condition proxy for dry or stressed vegetation.

name: NASA FIRMS Area API
description: Near-real-time MODIS/VIIRS active-fire detections by bounding box; requires a free MAP_KEY.

name: EPA AirNow API
description: Real-time PM2.5/AQI and fire/smoke map data by location; requires a free key.

name: PurpleAir API
description: Real-time and historical PM2.5 from a crowdsourced network of low-cost air quality sensors; requires a key, with usage metered in points.

name: California Forest Observatory
description: Satellite-derived forest structure and wildfire hazard drivers for California; downloads require a free account.

name: Vibrant Planet: CAL FIRE wildfire hazard & risk modeling (2020-2035)
description: Statewide California fuelscapes, fire behavior, and wildfire risk simulations under multiple future scenarios; downloads require a sign-up form.

name: Vibrant Planet: Crown fire probability
description: Probability of canopy-driven fire across the contiguous U.S. at 30 m; downloads require a sign-up form.

name: Vibrant Planet: Fire severity (Parks et al. 1984-2023)
description: Severity of large western U.S. fires from 1984 to 2023 at 30 m; downloads require a sign-up form.

name: Vibrant Planet: Cumulative fire count (1950-2023)
description: How many times each 30 m pixel of the western U.S. burned from 1950 to 2023; downloads require a sign-up form.

name: Vibrant Planet: Wildfire ignition probability
description: Human-caused, lightning-caused, and composite ignition probability for the western and southeastern U.S. at 120 m; downloads require a sign-up form.

name: Vibrant Planet: pFRID 2023 fire regime interval departure
description: How contemporary fire intervals differ from modeled historical conditions across 17 western states; downloads require a sign-up form.

name: CDC PLACES
description: Census-tract and county chronic-disease prevalence, including asthma and COPD.

name: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index
description: Census-tract and county social vulnerability data.

name: EPA EJScreen
description: Block-group environmental justice index available as a static download and documented API.

name: DOE EAGLE-I power outage data
description: County-level outage counts at 15-minute intervals for 2014-2024; live system access is restricted.

name: Dryad WUMI2024a wildfire database
description: Quality-controlled 1984-2024 fire events with per-fire burn grids.

name: ESSD WUMI2024a data paper
description: Earth System Science Data article describing the WUMI2024a wildfire database.

name: Dryad CA wildfire smoke PM2.5 exposure
description: Modeled daily smoke PM2.5 by census tract for 2008-2018.
